## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] Change is limited to the approved product/repository scope.
- [ ] No production infrastructure, DNS, billing, email-routing, or account-ownership change is included unless explicitly approved.
- [ ] No customer data, PHI, credentials, secrets, private keys, tokens, or private operational details are included.

## Architecture and security

- [ ] Relevant ADRs and authoritative documentation were reviewed.
- [ ] Provider-specific details remain outside the domain where applicable.
- [ ] Authorization, retention, audit, and sensitive-data boundaries remain consistent.
- [ ] No compliance claim is introduced without an approved end-to-end basis.

## Validation

List the exact checks executed and results.

## Cost / external dependencies

State any new recurring cost, provider, service, runtime dependency, or lock-in impact. Use `none` when none.

## Production / infrastructure changes

State explicitly whether production or infrastructure changes occurred. Use `none` when none.

## Follow-up / approval gates

List unresolved decisions or approvals required before merge or before a later release.
